transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started with the weekly logistics huddle. I need to hear from both medical logistics and maintenance control on your current cargo-handling or movement constraints before I sign off on today's pallet allocation. We have two pallet positions available — one powered, one unpowered — and three cargoes staged: medical vaccine cases, an avionics diagnostic module, and water-purification cartridges. Please go ahead and report your constraints.
